tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Searches Well Told's catalog of custom gifts for clients, employees, teams and events: glassware, tumblers and bottles personalized with a map of a meaningful place, a logo or text. Use it when someone is looking for custom, branded or personalized gifts in quantity. Filters by budget per unit, quan

tools.name: show_products
tools.description: Shows up to 8 products from search_catalog in an interactive grid where the buyer can see photos and prices and pick the products they want proofs for. Pass logo_id once a logo is uploaded so a pick can go straight to a proof.

tools.name: upload_logo
tools.description: Stores the buyer's own logo with Well Told and checks it for etching problems, returning a logo_id and plain-language warnings. Accepts a chat attachment (logo_file, where the app can pass attachments to tools), a logo_url the buyer pasted, or the upload_code from an earlier call. Called with no arg

tools.name: generate_proof
tools.description: Creates a draft design the same way the Well Told customizer does and shows it in the proof viewer (flat preview, 3D view, warnings, approval checkboxes). design_type "map_logo" (default): a map of a location in a Well Told map style, plus the buyer's logo; needs location. design_type "logo_only": f

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Prices a design (design_id) or a product (product_id) at a quantity from Well Told's live store prices: unit price, setup fees, shipping fee, total, lead time, estimated ship and delivery dates, budget check, and the single-sample price. Shows the quote card, where the buyer can continue to welltold

tools.name: save_design
tools.description: Records the buyer's approval of a draft design. Used by the proof viewer's Approve button after the buyer ticks the proof approval and logo rights checkboxes; it requires both confirmations.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Builds a welltolddesign.com cart link that adds an approved design at the buyer's quantity, with the same design details the Well Told customizer puts on a cart line. Used by the quote card's and proof viewer's buttons. sample: true adds a single unit. Nothing is ordered until the buyer pays on well

tools.name: get_design_status
tools.description: Looks up where a buyer's designs stand: proof history, approval, and hand-off to checkout on welltolddesign.com. It does not see paid orders or shipping tracking.
